name: Klub gornichnyh
source:
Mahito has dreamed since childhood of working as a personal servant, just like his father.
Helping him achieve this goal are high school club's members — four charming maid-girls.

Mahito will not only hone his skills but also learn a great deal about his girlfriends!
translation:
真人自幼便梦想着能像父亲一样，成为一名专职私人侍从。
而帮助他实现这一目标的，正是高中社团里的成员们——四位迷人的女仆少女。

真人不仅能在此磨炼侍奉技艺，还将深入了解他可爱的女朋友们！
